messages:
sam: wrapping up the BlueWave POC. need a quick deprovision checklist: revoke hosted keys, decommission dedicated pool, shut down VPC endpoints, and ensure no raw customer data remains in logs or embedding stores. target: complete within 48h.

rita: noted. can we confirm whether BlueWave requested any telemetry exports? they mentioned storing usage for billing.

jon: I handled the dedicated pool earlier. pool id: pool-bluewave-2025. plan is to cordon nodes, drain, grab performance dumps, then delete. will pause final delete if legal requests hold.

infra_ops: proposed steps and commands:
```
# revoke hosted API key (admin-tool)
admin-tool api-keys revoke --id hw-bluewave-key-9 --actor infra_ops

# cordon + drain pool (redctl)
redctl pool cordon --id pool-bluewave-2025
redctl pool drain --id pool-bluewave-2025 --timeout 900

# teardown VPC endpoint
terraform apply -var 'vpc_id=vpc-bluewave' -target=module.vpc_endpoint -auto-approve
```
Also: scrub ephemeral /tmp model caches and remove any model cache snapshots under /var/lib/redwood/cache/bluewave*.

sam: great, include steps to rotate any service account keys that were provisioned specifically for the POC. cloud console keys need to be removed.

rita: BlueWave asked to keep anonymized usage metrics for 60 days for internal billing reconciliation. contract has 30 days default; we'll need sales-ops signoff to keep 60. tagging @nora-legal.

nora-legal: quick read: default retention in SOW is 30 days. to honor 60 days we need an addendum signed or an email confirmation from an authorized customer contact. otherwise we must enforce 30 days. if you have exported anonymized aggregates (no PII), that is generally ok, but document it.

jon: I'll prepare the metrics export (anonymized) and hold deletion of raw logs. we can push aggregates to gs://redwood-poc-archives/bluewave/metrics/ with restricted ACL.

finance_bot: POC-bluewave created: 2025-01-15. billing center: poc-bw-07. current unbilled usage: $3,452. Please allocate final charges before pool deletion.

infra_ops: small note: embeddings index uses table embeddings_bw in our vectorstore. by default we persist vector + hashed id. customer raw text is NOT persisted unless ingestion flag set. for this POC ingestion_flag=false. i'll run a query to confirm there are zero entries with raw_text != NULL.

sam: excellent. jon, infra_ops, split tasks and post back with timestamps. also produce one-line audit lines so we can paste into the customer handoff doc.

jon: starting cordon at 1820043300. drain in progress.

infra_ops: running check: `SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings_bw WHERE raw_text IS NOT NULL;` -> 0. embedding raw text: none.

rita: customer did request one snapshot of a model runtime for debugging on 2025-02-20. do we have that snapshot stored?

infra_ops: snapshot present: s3://redwood-poc-snapshots/bluewave/runtime-20250220.tar.gz. default policy: snapshots live for 90 days unless customer asks otherwise. note: snapshot contains model weights + runtime logs; confirm with legal before deletion.

nora-legal: snapshot may contain derived logs. we need to confirm it contains no customer PII. request an MD5 + manifest of snapshot contents. do not delete until we have the manifest.

jon: pausing snapshot delete. will generate manifest and upload to secure bucket: gs://redwood-poc-legal/bluewave/manifests/1820043210-manifest.txt

infra_ops: key revoke result: `{status: "ok", key_id: "hw-bluewave-key-9", revoked_by: "infra_ops", time: "2025-03-25T09:02:10Z"}`. rotated service account keys: sa-bluewave-poc removed.

jon: pool drain complete at 1820043600. performance dumps collected and uploaded to gs://redwood-poc-archives/bluewave/dumps/1820043210-perf.zip

sam: good. infra_ops, once manifest is up and legal clears, please proceed to delete snapshot and caches. keep audit entries.

infra_ops: manifest uploaded at 1820043700. manifest shows no customer id strings and lists log files with hashes. posted to secure bucket.

nora-legal: reviewed manifest. snapshot contains only system logs and model artifacts, no customer PII. legal approves deletion after 7 days retention to allow customer retrieval. please record retention period in audit.

rita: customer hasn't requested retrieval. okay to proceed after 7 days. set deletion timestamp to 1820648400 (seven days).

finance_bot: reminder: allocate $3,452 usage to poc-bw-07 by 1820043800, else escalate.

infra_ops: invalidating caches now: `redctl cache purge --pattern bluewave:*` -> queued. backing up audit entries to gs://redwood-poc-audits/bluewave/1820043210-cleanup.json

jon: running terraform to remove VPC endpoints at 1820043850. will confirm when destroyed.

infra_ops: cache purge complete at 1820043888. audit line: `2025-03-25T09:08:08Z cache-purge by infra_ops`.

jon: VPC endpoints destroyed at 1820043925. terraform output shows resources removed.

sam: final checklist before closing:
- hosted key revoked (infra_ops): done
- service account keys rotated (infra_ops): done
- pool drained + deleted (jon): scheduled delete after legal approval window
- caches invalidated (infra_ops): done
- embeddings raw text check (infra_ops): passed
- snapshot manifest reviewed (jon/nora-legal): passed
- billing allocation (finance_bot): pending

nora-legal: legal ok with 7-day hold on snapshot; no other holds.

finance_bot: billing allocated to poc-bw-07 at 1820043950.

jon: proceeding to delete pool final at 1820043970: command `redctl pool delete --id pool-bluewave-2025 --force` executed. response: `{"status":"deleted","id":"pool-bluewave-2025","deleted_by":"jon","time":"2025-03-25T09:12:50Z"}`

sam: excellent. paste the short audit entry here and close thread. good job team. :tada:

infra_ops: final audit summary: `{"poc":"bluewave","actions":[{"t":"2025-03-25T09:02:10Z","a":"revoke-key","by":"infra_ops"},{"t":"2025-03-25T09:08:08Z","a":"cache-purge","by":"infra_ops"},{"t":"2025-03-25T09:12:50Z","a":"pool-delete","by":"jon"}],"snapshot_hold_days":"7","retention_override":"60_requested"}`. closing thread.
